plan: Since this is round 1 of 1, and I have a value of $25, I need to bid strategically to maximize my potential profit. Bidding too low risks losing to a lower valuation, while bidding too high risks overpaying. I will employ a conservative strategy, bidding slightly above the midpoint of my value to try and win without overspending. I will avoid dominated strategies by not bidding my maximum value.

A bid of $17.5 seems reasonable.
